In this video, I share a gentle and effective yoga routine specifically designed to help manage and heal Varicocele and Hydrocele from the comfort of your home.
Many men suffer from these conditions, which can lead to discomfort, pain, and other health issues like infertility or erectile dysfunction. These yoga asanas focus on improving blood circulation and reducing swelling in the affected areas.
In this video, you will learn:
• Baddha Konasana (Bound Angle Pose): Improves circulation and provides a deep stretch.
• Viparita Karani (Legs-Up-The-Wall): An essential posture for blood flow.
